news.title: In This State, an Intense Fight in the G.O.P. for Control of the Right
news.summary: Wyoming, one of the most conservative states, has a legislature divided between a hard-right House and a merely right Senate. Ultraconservatives want a complete takeover in the Aug. 18 primaries.
